verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers economic nexus monitoring, recording off-Stripe transactions and reporting, but nothing about marketplace facilitator transactions (Amazon, app stores) where the facilitator collected the tax. There is also no evidence of counting such sales toward nexus while excluding them from remittance. Generic nexus monitoring and external-transaction recording are adjacent features, not the facilitator modeling this story asks for.

support.subject: As a finance lead, marketplace sales are modeled correctly — transactions where a facilitator (Amazon, app stores) collected the tax are tracked for nexus and reporting without being double-remitted
